name: Shadows of the Republic
source:
The nation bleeds of faith, warlords split the table, and Japan demands a seat. Navigate the maze of intrigue and the web of faces as you avoid traps, find leads and question allies and enemies alike. Figure out your goals and how you wish for the future of the nation to manifest. Banners of blood will be raised in your stead. Do not let them fall, not yet. 

This game is set in Beijing during WW2, where you play as a student turned intelligent asset among the Nationalists, Communists and Japanese Collaborators. You can explore objects, investigate people, and develop personality traits based on your actions and the words you choose throughout the narrative. 

[Edited from [url=https://monowaystudios.itch.io/shadows-of-the-republic]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
山河泣血、信仰崩塌，各路军阀割据一方，日本侵略者更是咄咄逼人地妄图分一杯羹。穿行于错综复杂的阴谋迷宫与千面人心织就的罗网之间，避开重重陷阱、搜寻蛛丝马迹，审视并盘问身边的盟友与敌人。厘清你真正的目标，抉择你期盼这个国家的未来走向何方。染血的旌旗将代你高高扬起——别让它们倒下，至少现在还不能。

本作背景设定于二战时期的北平，你将扮演一名周旋于国民党、共产党与日伪势力之间的学生情报人员。在叙事推进的过程中，你可以调查各类物品、摸排各方人物，并根据自己的所作所为与言辞抉择塑造出独特的性格特质。

[摘自[url=https://monowaystudios.itch.io/shadows-of-the-republic]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
